title: ✈️ Air Ambulance Services in India
intro: Medical emergencies require fast, safe, and reliable air transport. We provide 24/7 air ambulance services in partnership with India’s top aviation and medical evacuation providers.

sections.heading: 🚑 Types of Air Ambulance Services We Provide
points: Domestic Air Transfers: From any Indian city to top hospitals
International Evacuations: From Africa, Middle East, Asia, or Europe to India
Bed-to-Bed Transfers: Complete coordination from the patient’s location to ICU
Organ Transport Flights: Fast transfers for transplant cases
Commercial Stretcher Transfers: Cost-effective option on regular flights

sections.heading: 🩺 Onboard Medical Facilities
points: Trained critical care doctors & nurses
Advanced life-support systems (ICU setup)
Ventilators, defibrillators & emergency drugs
Continuous monitoring during transfer
Special arrangements for pediatric & neonatal patients

sections.heading: 🌍 Why Patients Choose Our Air Ambulance Service
points: Available 24/7, 365 days
Fast coordination with hospitals for ICU/OT readiness
Cost-effective international transfers (up to 60% cheaper than Western providers)
Global partnerships for visa & airport clearance support
Trusted by patients from Africa, Middle East, CIS, and Asia

sections.heading: 💰 Air Ambulance Cost in India
points: Domestic Flights (India): $5,000 – $10,000
International Flights: $15,000 – $40,000 depending on distance
Commercial Stretcher Transfer: $2,500 – $7,000

cta.headline: 📞 Book Emergency Air Ambulance Now
points: Fast response, anywhere in the world
ICU-equipped aircraft with medical team
Trusted service for critical cases
